about.name: Muhammad Maulana Yusuf
about.title: Frontend Developer
about.summary: Experienced Frontend Developer with a solid background in Informatics Engineering (GPA: 3.54). Proven track record of translating complex Figma designs into responsive enterprise applications. Experienced in building and maintaining web modules across financial systems (Bank Mandiri) and government service platforms (Bea Cukai) using Angular, React.js, and TypeScript.

items.company: Direktorat Jenderal Bea dan Cukai (Outsourced by PT Altros Teknologi)
desc: Developed and maintained core microfrontend modules within the CEISA 4.0 and Portal Pengguna Jasa systems using React.js and Ant Design.
Collaborated closely with backend teams to integrate RESTful APIs, ensuring secure data handling and responsive layouts.
Identified, debugged, and resolved system-critical frontend bugs, enhancing portal stability for external users.

items.company: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk (Outsourced by PT Lawencon International)
desc: Developed core frontend modules for corporate banking services (Export Letter of Credit, Document Tracker, Auto-Debit, EIPP, and VA Collection) using Angular and TypeScript.
Built responsive, utility-first UI elements with Tailwind CSS based on Figma design specifications.
Participated in team code reviews, optimized component modularity, and maintained technical documentation in Confluence.
Developed HRIS (Linov) frontend features for payroll, attendance, and employee management using Angular and PrimeNG.
Translated wireframes into responsive modular UIs, improving codebase cleanliness and maintainability.
Managed technical virtual infrastructure (VMIX/Zoom integration) and live stream logistics for national-scale webinars.
